name: Ajin Electronic Components Co.,Ltd
summary: Ajin Electronic Components Co.,Ltd produces and sells automotive components in South Korea. The company provides automotive components, such as photocatalytic module, brake control unit, direction module, fuel cell dc-dc converter, suspension control unit, led headlamp, automotive radar, on-board charger, climate control head, PTC heater, battery heating heater, pulse with modulation, actuator control unit, torque angle sensor, BLDC motor driver, voltage regulator, and BTSI solenoid products. It offers ambient light controller and surface heating heater products. In addition, the company provides aluminium electrolytic capacitors and tantalum capacitors. The company was formerly known as Daewoo Electronic Components Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ajin Electronic Components Co.,Ltd in October 2024. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Jeongeup-si, South Korea.
